I wanted to give this plain front yard a premium upgrade, so I grabbed my tools and got to work! Watching the real progress unfold in this timelapse is incredibly satisfying. Here is a step-by-step breakdown of how I built this modern rock garden: 1️⃣ First, I mapped out a smooth, curved border on the grass using white spray paint. 2️⃣ Next, I dug out the edge along the line and laid down a heavy-duty black weed barrier. 3️⃣ I installed a sleek stone border, block by block, to keep everything neat and contained. 4️⃣ Then came the best part—pouring and leveling tons of crisp white river rocks for that beautiful, high-contrast look. 5️⃣ Finally, I styled the space by placing a dark statement sphere, planting some architectural agaves, and adding solar pathway lights. Seeing the before and after of this build progress makes all the hard work totally worth it! 2026 YARD FINALE | DAY 4 — THE FINAL CUT! Well, y'all, we made it to Day 4! Today I'm cutting the grass, edging, and wrapping things up for the 2026 lawn season! The last time I cut my grass was September 29th, almost a whole month ago! And as you can see, it hasn't grown much. It's also not nearly as deep green as it was during the summer. The cooler weather has definitely slowed things down! So this might officially be my last cut of 2026! As this lawn season comes to an end, I can truly say I've enjoyed everything I've learned about my yard this year. More than anything, it's been a blessing to be physically fit and able to do all this work myself. I enjoyed every bit of it, even on those 100-degree days! It's been a good year, y'all.
